channel.title: Paksh: Science & Tech
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: BepiColombo Probe Reaches Mercury Orbit After Eight-Year Journey
item.description: The BepiColombo probe has successfully entered Mercury's orbit, marking the first visitor to the planet in over a decade. The mission, a joint effort by the European Space Agency and the Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency, embarked on its… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 3 · Right 1.

item.title: Meta AI Executive Warns of Superintelligence Arrival
item.description: A top executive at Meta's AI division has warned that artificial superintelligence is 'arriving'. Alexandr Wang, chief AI officer at Meta, stated that the remaining challenges for AI to surpass human capabilities globally are no longer… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: China and US Vie for AI Dominance Amid Global Concerns
item.description: The global race for artificial intelligence (AI) supremacy is intensifying between China and the United States, with both nations driving advancements through new standards and competition. This technological race raises concerns about… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: China's J-20 Stealth Fighter Faces Combat Readiness Challenges
item.description: China's J-20 fifth-generation stealth fighter, while a marvel of modern aviation, faces significant upkeep demands. Its advanced features, such as radar-absorbing materials, can degrade over time, posing challenges for maintenance… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Mathematician Claims AI Helped Solve 167-Year-Old Riemann Hypothesis
item.description: Levent Alpöge, a mathematician at Anthropic, claims to have solved the 167-year-old Riemann Hypothesis with the assistance of Anthropic's AI tool, Claude. Alpöge stated it took six weeks to develop the proof using the AI. The mathematical… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 5 · Right 0.

item.title: Google Pledges $5 Million for AI Research at IIT Kharagpur
item.description: Google has pledged $5 million to IIT Kharagpur to support artificial intelligence research and education. The funding aims to advance AI initiatives at the institution. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 2.

item.title: OpenAI Proposes Limits on AI Development, Suggests Progress Metric
item.description: OpenAI has called for common limits on artificial intelligence development and urged the industry to adopt 'perplexity' as a metric for measuring progress. This proposal aims to establish shared guidelines for the advancement of AI… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: AI Robots Poised for Delivery Role Amid Urban Challenges
item.description: AI-powered delivery robots are being developed to navigate urban environments, facing challenges such as pedestrian traffic and traffic signals. China is noted as a significant player in the development and deployment of these robots… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: AI researcher warns of superhuman systems by 2027
item.description: An AI researcher from Anthropic has called for a slowdown in artificial intelligence development, warning that the emergence of superhuman AI systems could lead to widespread joblessness. The researcher suggested that such advanced AI… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Indian Universities Rank High in Global Interdisciplinary Science
item.description: India has shown strong participation in interdisciplinary science globally, with Saveetha University retaining its top rank within India. Jamia Millia Islamia was ranked 69th globally in the Times Interdisciplinary Science Rankings 2027… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: A China-based artificial intelligence safety group has briefed several US AI laboratories, including OpenAI. The group's activities have raised questions about Western perceptions of AI safety in China. The Financial Times suggests that… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: AI Platform SPZAORA Aims to Transform Interior Design for Architects
item.description: SPZAORA, a platform leveraging artificial intelligence, is being introduced to transform interior design processes for architects. The technology aims to enhance design capabilities and workflows within the architectural profession. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Leonid Meteor Shower Peaks This Week
item.description: The Leonid meteor shower is peaking this week, with the best viewing time expected on Tuesday night. This meteor shower is notable as it is described as 'the shower that started it all'. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.description: OpenAI will discontinue its older ChatGPT voice modes, including the standard and advanced versions, on December 11. Users will be required to transition to the live voice mode. Additionally, OpenAI has introduced a "Business Hub" tool… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.description: Google has expanded access to its Gemini 4 Carbon artificial intelligence (AI) model, making it available to developers, businesses, scientists, and consumers. The advanced AI engine is designed for complex tasks including software… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Meta develops humanoid robot with Chinese startup Fourier
item.description: Meta has developed a prototype humanoid robot in collaboration with the Chinese startup company Fourier, according to a report by The Information. The report indicates that Meta built the robot with Fourier. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: ISRO Successfully Launches NVS-03 Satellite
item.description: The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) successfully launched the NVS-03 satellite using the GSLV-F18 rocket. Telangana Chief Minister Revanth Reddy congratulated ISRO scientists and engineers on the successful launch. Prime Minister… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 3.

item.title: NASA Crew Completes Year-Long Simulated Mars Mission
item.description: A four-member crew has emerged from a simulated Mars habitat after spending 378 days inside. The mission was conducted by NASA. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: MeitY Releases Handbook for Secure Data Sharing for AI
item.description: The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) has released a handbook on the Digital Ecosystems for Health and Education (DEPHA) framework. This handbook aims to facilitate trusted and secure data sharing, which is crucial… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: AI Companies Compete with Advanced Coding Agents
item.description: DeepSeek has released a prototype of an enhanced coding agent designed to compete with Anthropic's Claude Code. Anthropic, which filed to go public on the US stock market on October 26, has acknowledged the potential dangers of AI in a… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Google Project Suncatcher Achieves Space-Based AI Milestone
item.description: Google has achieved a significant milestone in its 'Project Suncatcher' initiative, which focuses on space-based AI computing. A satellite involved in the project successfully transmitted the first AI-generated response back to Earth. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.
